posts.body:
Our first child was born last month and we are getting into the hang of baby money saving - any advice welcome!

The last Aldi Baby Event was mid Jan and we stocked up on nappies ahead of her arrival - we also got lots of freebies from various brands and having now used them up over her first month, we find the Aldi Mamia nappies to be very good quality and value.

Aldi don't seem to publish their special buy events very far in advance so my question is whether anyone has an idea of how often they have baby events, and what times of year they are at? Is there a pattern that more experienced parents know of or does is vary each year? For example, if they had four events per year, and the last was mid Jan, is it reasonable to assume that there will be one in April sometime?

Thanks
